statement: let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℚ := !![0,5;1,0]; A.trace=0 ∧ A.det ≠ 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0031 · 用非零迹零元素区分单点与整层迹
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0031 · Separate the trace of a point from the trace of its lattice

brief.zh: 取基 1,√5，写出乘以 √5 的矩阵。单点取迹可完全抵消。
brief.en: Use the basis 1,√5 for multiplication by √5. The trace of one nonzero element can vanish.
